plan: A spectral rider who charges at full speed at his target and knocks it back towards his team.
aSurveiller: His E (Devastating Charge). He gains speed and his next attack knocks you back: keep an escape spell when he charges.
contrer: Slow him: the faster he goes, the more damage he deals.
Keep a spell for his charge (E): it knocks you towards his team.
Spread out when he casts his R: it fears all nearby enemies.

sorts.P: More damage with his bonus speed.
sorts.W: Resistances and healing when dealing damage.
sorts.E: Gains speed; the next attack knocks back.
sorts.R: Charges with his riders and fears enemies.

momentFort: Gets ahead by clearing his camps fast, then chains plays. Slow him: his speed is his strength from level 3.
